kind: independent deterministic retrospective audit of published legacy DEVELOPMENT artifacts; no model/container/evaluator execution

source_evidence.evidence: worker-declared executed wrapper, source inspected; executed bytes not independently attested

source_semantics: The inspected legacy AccountedModel.query increments its logical counter once, then delegates to the pinned model; its _query records each physical attempt and returns the response without changing agent messages.

DefaultAgent.query increments n_calls before model.query and appends the returned assistant only after model.query returns. DefaultAgent.step then executes the parsed action and appends its observation.

Pinned parse_regex_actions returns exactly one action or raises FormatError carrying a user message whose extra.interrupt_type is FormatError. The model attaches the raw response and cost before rethrowing.

DefaultAgent.run appends every FormatError message on both handler branches; add_messages only extends the list and serialize retains that complete list. An uncaught non-format exception appends an exit and raises; it cannot silently continue to call9.

Accordingly a successful physical response alone is insufficient. This audit additionally requires exactly eight alternating assistant/observation pairs before assistant9, no format-error marker, exactly one action matching the pinned regex per pair, matching response usage/finish reason, and attempt_end(k) <= assistant_timestamp(k) <= observation_timestamp(k) <= attempt_start(k+1) for k=1..8.

All112 first-eight-call links pass for the14 runs issuing call9. The only recorded FormatError is in sympy/large after12 assistant messages, outside each audited first-eight-call prefix. The full prefix before the ninth assistant is therefore the agent history for logical call9 under the inspected source and recorded timestamps.
This is an archive-specific reconstruction under source/record integrity assumptions, not a generic legacy-report acceptance rule or independent observation of executed remote code.
cost_scope: Known token subtotals exclude unobserved failed-attempt usage; episode wall excludes setup/serving/preflight/evaluator overhead. Recorded zero monetary cost is not a measured total cost.
